# Third-party notices

The `polish-writing` and `polish-ui` skills and `style/rules.toml` are written for this plugin. Their pattern
lists and checklists adapt ideas from the sources below. Where a source is MIT or Apache-2.0 we adapted ideas
with attribution; where it is CC BY-SA or CC BY-NC-SA we only cite it and wrote our own wording. No source text
is copied verbatim.
